iRule(1)						BIG-IP TMSH Manual						  iRule(1)

IMAP::enable
       Enable IMAP protocol handler.

SYNOPSIS
       IMAP::enable

DESCRIPTION
       Enable IMAP protocol handler for IMAP message processing. This will enable detection of STARTTLS for IMAP.

RETURN VALUE
VALID DURING
       SERVER_CONNECTED CLIENT_ACCEPTED

EXAMPLES
	when CLIENT_ACCEPTED {
	    if { !([IP::addr [IP::client_addr] equals 10.0.0.0/8]) } {
		IMAP::enable
	    }
	}

HINTS
SEE ALSO
CHANGE LOG
       @BIGIP-13.1.0 --First introduced the command.

BIG-IP							    2022-04-12							  iRule(1)
